name: Events Grid
author: K.Paradorn
description: Dynamic event management and responsive event grid shortcode for Elementor and WordPress.

sections.description:
Events Grid replaces hardcoded HTML event cards with dynamic event posts managed from the WordPress admin area.

  • Custom post type for events
  • Event Categories taxonomy for filtering
  • Meta boxes for dates, venue, booth number, speaker badge, and URL
  • Responsive CSS Grid layout
  • Shortcode support for Elementor shortcode widget
  • Upcoming and past event sections with optional headings
  • Output caching for improved performance
  • Full REST API support
  • Settings page with configurable past-event fade-out period
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Added Events > Settings page with a "Hide past events after N days" option (0 = show all past events).

1.1.1

  • Added Modified By column to the Events admin list table showing which user last edited each event.

1.1.0

  • Added Event Categories taxonomy — filter events by category in the shortcode using category attribute.
  • Added upcoming_label and past_label shortcode attributes for section headings.
  • Fixed N+1 database query — all event meta now loaded in a single query per grid.
  • Added shortcode output caching (1-hour transient, auto-invalidated on save/delete).
  • Added Start Date, End Date, Venue, and Country columns to the Events admin list table.
  • Registered all meta fields with the REST API.
  • Moved Google Fonts from CSS @import to WordPress asset pipeline.
  • Removed CSS !important declarations in favour of scoped selectors.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
